items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Cam phasers or the water pump are often done at the same time. Cost rises a lot if the valves were damaged.

items.job: Rebuild transmission with new 3-5-reverse wave plate
items.note: If the transmission is badly damaged, a remanufactured unit costs more.

items.t: Power steering pump leaks and whine
items.note: Some leaks come from hoses or the steering rack. A new rack costs much more.

items.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall)
items.job: Repair seat air bag wiring connectors (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power liftgate struts wear and gate drops (recall)
items.note: Price is for both struts. Recall may cover it for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Replace rear A/C evaporator and recharge
items.note: A front evaporator needs the dash taken apart and costs much more.
